title: Paul Hellyer: dying Canadian emergency management head sat inside a craft at Area 51
place_text: Bradford, Ontario; Langley, Virginia; Area 51, Nevada

tellings.quote: go wrong. And he said, "I got taken to Washington to Langley. I signed my life away and then they took me to Area 51 and I sat inside a craft."

plain: A dying Canadian official who had run emergency management is said to have confessed that he was taken to the CIA at Langley, made to sign his silence away, and then flown to Area 51, a secret US test site in Nevada, where he sat inside a craft. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron tells Michels this as something the Canadian politician Paul Hellyer told him, quoting the man's words as Hellyer gave them: "I signed my life away and then they took me to Area 51 and I sat inside a craft." If true, it would mean the US was holding a craft and showing it to allied officials.
